found.quote: You need to ask yourself whether you are using AI tools to do the thinking for you or simply to assist you in thinking better.
Guides, tutorials, and resources on Generative AI created by DMU and curated from trusted sources

unsure.quote: DMU recognises that some generative AI tools can help develop academic skills.
unsure.why: Recognises benefit but no commitment to enabling AI.

unsure.quote: Some tools can help with finding academic papers whilst others can help with generating images, summarising, making sense of materials and proofreading.
unsure.why: Describes tool capabilities, not explicit permission.

unsure.quote: If you have been permitted to use AI tools in your work there are ways to acknowledge and referencing their use.
unsure.why: Pointer to ways to acknowledge, not advisory duty.
